title: Taliban Marks Five Years in Power; UN Warns of Ongoing Human Rights Crisis
detail: Taliban leaders mark the fifth anniversary of their return to power in Afghanistan on August 15, 2021. A UN official issued a stark warning about the ongoing human rights crisis under Taliban governance, citing continued restrictions on women and girls, suppression of press freedom, and lack of accountability for abuses. The anniversary comes amid deepening international isolation and persistent humanitarian emergency.

media.caption: Taliban leaders mark five years in power as UN warns of ongoing human rights crisis
